# Tallowmere Locker API documentation

The Tallowmere Locker API lets shippers book compartments in Tallowmere's parcel lockers,
follow parcels through drop-off and collection, and receive events as they happen. The
current major version is 3. Version 2 was retired on 1 October 2026.

## Guides

- Authentication: https://docs.tallowmere.example/v3/authentication
- Errors: https://docs.tallowmere.example/v3/errors
- Rate limits: https://docs.tallowmere.example/v3/rate-limits
- Webhooks: https://docs.tallowmere.example/v3/webhooks
- SDKs and tools: https://docs.tallowmere.example/sdks
- Changelog: https://docs.tallowmere.example/changelog

## Reference (v3)

- Lockers: https://docs.tallowmere.example/v3/reference/lockers
- Holds: https://docs.tallowmere.example/v3/reference/holds

## Legacy (v2, retired)

- Authentication (v2): https://docs.tallowmere.example/v2/authentication
- Reservations (v2): https://docs.tallowmere.example/v2/reference/reservations

The API's base URL is `https://api.tallowmere.example`; the sandbox's is
`https://sandbox.tallowmere.example`.
